shipped_rows.title_o: Voluntary turnover and job performance: Curvilinearity and the moderating influences of salary growth and promotions.
shipped_rows.outcome_quote:
Survival regression revealed that performance is curvilinearly related to quits and that bonus pay deterred superior performers from leaving more than did pay increases. Further, the average number of job levels advanced per promotion rather than promotion rate increased quit risks.

---

" This analysis replicated Trevor et al.’s (1997) finding that wage growth deters turnover. (p. 1209)"

---

"Although not as pronounced as Trevor et al.’s (1997) finding, top performers (rated 5) exhibited a lower survival rate than those evaluated 4, as Figure 2 shows. (p. 1209)"

---

"This finding rejected Hypothesis 3a and failed to replicate Trevor et al.’s (1997) work." (p. 1209)
